metadata.alt_text: Two scatterplots showing age and mean trial time relationship for the 32 fastest and 32 slowest participants. The fastest participants are mostly in the 18-40 range, with 3 people older than that, and include 7 participants who had reported motor impairments. The slowest participants are more dispersed in age, from just over 25 to almost 70, and include 5 participants without motor impairments.
metadata.domain_context: From a paper published at ASSETS (2020).
